symptom: Chipotle cloud application exited before opening a browser page; direct startup probe reported No usable sandbox.
root_cause: Ubuntu AppArmor restricted user namespaces for the downloaded Playwright Chromium executable. Production enables chromium_sandbox=True; the installation probe used Playwright defaults with sandbox disabled.
why_tests_missed: The smoke test launched headless nonpersistent Chromium with different sandbox settings from real applications.
fix: Install an exact-executable AppArmor namespace exception and verify headed persistent Chromium startup with chromium_sandbox=True under Xvfb. Keep host restrictions and Chromium sandbox enabled.
prevention: Run the production browser startup mode on the deployment host after every browser install or upgrade, before assigning applications to the worker.
